issue.title: Changing mode to GUIDED
issue.body:
Hi,
I ran the takeoff_and_land example.
In some cases it did not takeoff. Now, I figured out that this was because the arducopter wasn't in GUIDED mode.
What can be the easiest way to command it to GUIDED mode ? 
At what class (Action, System,  ?) is that implemented.
Thanks

comments.body:
[Here is](https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK/blob/main/src/mavsdk/plugins/action/action_impl.cpp#L387) the ardupilot implementation of the takeoff. My understanding is that if it is not in GUIDED mode (which MAVSDK calls "offboard"), then it should set it to GUIDED and then takeoff.

Which version of MAVSDK are you using?

Oh, it is fixed in the main branch (which will become MAVSDK v2 at some point), but not in the v1.4.13 branch (which is the latest release): https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK/blob/v1.4.13/src/mavsdk/plugins/action/action_impl.cpp.

So you have two solutions:
1. Build MAVSDK from source from the main branch, so that you get the fix
2. Open a PR backporting the fix from main to the v1.4 branch, and then we could make a v1.4.14 release

I don't know how many similar fixes are in `main` and not in `v1.4` (apparently `v1.4` is currently 438 commits behind `main`: https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK/tree/v1.4). If I was using Ardupilot, I would personally build MAVSDK from source to make sure I don't miss other similar fixes.

But that's your choice :blush:.

I would suggest to use the main branch for building the library as well since there are many Ardupilot related changes which are not in the latest release. Closing for now, please reopen if the issue persists with the main branch as well.

Hello, I know this issue is closed but I'd like to add to it and perhaps suggest that it is reopened... I have changed to main branch, built from source etc. and the `takeoff` MavSDK action does work now... sometimes. I have been using the ArduPilot SITL environment to test my code and have noticed that I sometimes get a seg fault when using the `takeoff` command. I have tried out quite a few things and I *think* I have boiled it down to the `takeoff` command switching to `GUIDED` mode when there is no `position` as outlined in the logs shown in the image below. Based on [action.h](https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK/blob/48f1ad0325ecdcb8075d7ffd0cd7a8323af12fb3/src/mavsdk/plugins/action/include/plugins/action/action.h#L84), I am getting a takeoff response of 13 which relates to `Failed` as shown below: ```cpp enum class Result { Unknown, /**< @brief Unknown result. */ Success, /**< @brief Request was successful. */ NoSystem, /**< @brief No system is connected. */ ConnectionError, /**< @brief Connection error. */ Busy, /**< @brief Vehicle is busy. */ CommandDenied, /**< @brief Command refused by vehicle. */ CommandDeniedLandedStateUnknown, /**< @brief Command refused because landed state is unknown. */ CommandDeniedNotLanded, /**< @brief Command refused because vehicle not landed. */ Timeout, /**< @brief Request timed out. */ VtolTransitionSupportUnknown, /**< @brief Hybrid/VTOL transition support is unknown. */ NoVtolTransitionSupport, /**< @brief Vehicle does not support hybrid/VTOL transitions. */ ParameterError, /**< @brief Error getting or setting parameter. */ Unsupported, /**< @brief Action not supported. */ Failed, /**< @brief Action failed. */ }; ``` I have also noticed that if I let the simulator "settle" for some time, I don't get this seg fault, presumably because there is a position. I have tested this on a real drone as well and have a similar issue, though I cannot simply let the drone settle as real GPS dropout causes a loss of position at any arbitrary time. In any case, I am unable to catch this error so it pretty much breaks my code, though I also need it for a drone takeoff. Thanks for your help!

Hi Oliver, thanks for reporting the issue. Could you maybe try by changing the takeoff code in your local MAVSDK to switch to Stabilize flight mode instead of guided mode before takeoff? Please check it on SITL ;) Relevant code is here.

https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK/blob/48f1ad0325ecdcb8075d7ffd0cd7a8323af12fb3/src/mavsdk/plugins/action/action_impl.cpp#L387

Stabilize mode does not need position so should not create this particular issue:
https://ardupilot.org/copter/docs/stabilize-mode.html#stabilize-mode

What is your use-case? You would need position fix anyways before carrying out an auto mission right? In such a case waiting for a good fix before activating takeoff should be prudent. Or are you flying indoors?

Arducopter allows to takeoff in a selected number of flight modes out of which Guided was selected since MAVSDK is supposed to control the drone from such a mode. But I am open to discussing this further to find the best suitable mode for takeoff for most scenarios. Would also discuss this with the ArduPilot Dev team shortly.

issue.title: Building MAIN breaks Euler Angle Values - ArduCopter (Returns NaN but works in v1.4.16)

repository.name: MAVSDK
repository.description: API and library for MAVLink compatible systems written in C++ 20

issue.body:
Hello!

I have been following #2031 as I had the same issue with the `GUIDED mode`. I could not get a drone to take off without manually setting it to `GUIDED mode` first. Thankfully, this issue has been solved now, thanks dev team! 

I followed the suggestion of building `main` from source and that has worked nicely so thank you. Unfortunately however, my previously working eulerAngle telemetry gets are now broken/ only return NaN values.

As the title suggests, this issue is raised for ArduCopter (and Rover, Plane etc.) and *not* for PX4 (which I have tried `main` and it works fine).

This is the code I used:
```cpp
mavsdk::Telemetry::EulerAngle eulerAngle = telemetry->attitude_euler();
```
Using `main` I get the following results for euler angle params:
![Screenshot 2023-09-20 at 22 07 27](https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK/assets/49697817/6e0744b4-0246-4c74-9e43-6165b9100c0e)

Using `v1.4.16`, I get the following results for euler angle params:
![Screenshot 2023-09-20 at 22 05 02](https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK/assets/49697817/645fac70-3017-4c64-8ed8-8ff6c3902c0c)

I suspect there is some code change that needs to be modified back to the `v1.4.16` version?

Thanks for your help in advance!
